scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check

scriptDescriptions.dev: Start the local Vite development server for the browser UI.
scriptDescriptions.build: Regenerate the static SQLite database and build the production GitHub Pages site into dist/.
scriptDescriptions.preview: Serve the production build locally with Vite preview.
scriptDescriptions.archive:pointstreak-single-season: Fetch and archive raw XML for one season from Pointstreak, prompting before replacing existing XML files.
scriptDescriptions.archive:pointstreak-all-seasons: Run the interactive all-seasons Pointstreak raw XML archive workflow, prompting before replacing existing XML files.
scriptDescriptions.archive:pointstreak-all-players: Fetch Pointstreak player profile XML for every cross-season player id found in archived roster XML, prompting before replacing existing XML files.
scriptDescriptions.archive:seeds-generate-single-season: Generate deterministic NDJSON seed files for one season from archived raw XML.
scriptDescriptions.archive:seeds-generate-all-seasons: Generate deterministic NDJSON seed files for every configured archive season.
scriptDescriptions.archive:seeds-generate-mabl: Generate deterministic NDJSON seed files for the legacy MABL SQL dump under data/raw/jaxmabl.sql.
scriptDescriptions.archive:seeds-merge: Merge per-season NDJSON seed bundles into the all-seasons seed bundle under data/seeds/all, applying reviewed entity merges.
scriptDescriptions.archive:entity-merges-suggest: Generate separate human-reviewable player merge, team merge, and person-link candidate files from existing seed data.
scriptDescriptions.archive:db-build: Build the archive SQLite database from the merged all-seasons NDJSON seeds.
scriptDescriptions.archive:db-build-full: Generate season seeds, apply entity merges while merging seeds, import SQLite, and copy the static database to public/archive.sqlite.
scriptDescriptions.test:stat-fixtures: Run focused stat fixture checks for known player/team/game accuracy cases.
scriptDescriptions.scripts:help: Print this npm script list with descriptions.
scriptDescriptions.typecheck: Run TypeScript in no-emit mode to verify types.
scriptDescriptions.lint:fix: Run ESLint and apply safe automatic fixes.
scriptDescriptions.format:check: Check that matched files already use Prettier formatting.
scriptDescriptions.check: Run the standard local validation suite: typecheck, lint, and format check.
